title: TRE-4 Online Registration Finally Opens, Single-Stage Exam Set for Sep 22–27
detail: Nearly three weeks after formally postponing the exam to rework its format, the Bihar Public Service Commission opens online registration for Teacher Recruitment Examination 4.0 at bpsc.bihar.gov.in, confirming the single-stage, pen-and-paper format Chief Minister Choudhary conceded to on Aug 27. The commission lists 33,385 vacancies across primary, middle, secondary and higher-secondary posts — up from the original 32,388 after adding 111 music-teacher positions — with the written exam itself scheduled for Sep 22–27, 2026 and results expected in November.
